react_native_issues.issue: Console warning repeated on every page load: '\"shadow*\" style props are deprecated. Use \"boxShadow\".' Triggered by the new glow() helper in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts:36-38 (uses shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset) and cardShadow at :39. On React Native Web these should migrate to CSS `boxShadow` or use Platform.select. Non-blocking (styles still render) but pollutes console. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts:36-39

Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Same warning as iter4 — likely from an internal dependency or a component using the legacy prop. Non-blocking. Not caused by the visual restyle.
